subject: Logic
title: Paradox vs. Contradiction
description: Learn Paradox vs. Contradiction in one minute.

hook.text: "That's a contradiction!" people say when they mean paradox. But the two are very different.

buildup.text: A contradiction is simply false—"the ball is red and not red" can't be true under any interpretation.

discovery.text: A paradox appears contradictory but may hold a surprising truth once you think more deeply.

twist.text: "Less is more" sounds contradictory. But in design, removing clutter genuinely improves the result.

climax.text: Contradictions are dead ends. Paradoxes are doorways to new understanding.

punchline.text: Contradictions stop thought; paradoxes start it.

quiz.question: How does a paradox differ from a contradiction?
options: Paradoxes may reveal truth; contradictions are simply false
